craft_notes: Sthayin: song-level pranaya-sama; verse color = the answering begins (essence: 'teacher answers in verses'). Speaker shifts Śiṣya->Guru: first teacher-word of the work. Firing structures: (a) tense-fold — abhibhaṣati sma (mythic past) vs kathayati (present): two centuries in one verse; the em-dash IS the fold, ancient held open into present. English already carries it (spoke/tells), so no added 'now' — restraint, the dash does the work. (b) self-naming abhinavaguptaḥ: kept full, line-initial in line 2, the hinge the verse turns on (dhvani: the new-guarded one guards the transmission). (c) instrumental chain karikabhih... yogena (by verses, by view) -> parallel 'In... / in...' prepositions preserved. (d) adharakarikabhih recompounded 'support-verses' (T1/L0 gloss; L3 had split it). End-weight: lands on 'view' (drṣṭi — the seeing is the doctrine). Vowel arc: short i (him) -> long oo (view). Rupture: dash at line-1 end = centuries in one breath. Read aloud: falls on VIEW.

lines: In the support-verses the teacher spoke its pith to him —
Abhinavagupta tells it in Śiva's teaching view.
